description: This file defines an HTTP node class for an agent flow, enabling sending HTTP requests with configurable method, URL, headers, query parameters, body, and response handling. It includes logic for authentication, request configuration, and error handling.

classes.name: HTTP_Agentflow
classes.description: A class implementing an HTTP request node for agent flows, supporting various HTTP methods, headers, authentication, and response types.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request based on node data inputs, handles authentication, request configuration, response processing, and error handling.
